title: Kasdan Co. — Brand & Social
summary: The café we run, and the TikTok channel we make for it every week.
overview: Kasdan Co. is our own café in Sault Ste. Marie. We plan, shoot, edit and post its short-form content ourselves, and the channel has passed one million cumulative views on TikTok.

cover.alt: Dan O'Brien and Kass outside the Kasdan Co. storefront

idea.heading: How we run it
body: Content works when it's a habit, not a campaign. Every week we plan hooks around what's actually happening at the counter — new drinks, seasonal donuts, regulars and the odd stunt — then batch-shoot, edit and post.

Some of those stunts get bigger than the feed. On 27 October 2024, Daniel O'Brien and Kassandra Yee set the Guinness World Record for the tallest stack of doughnuts in one minute by a team of two — ten doughnuts — at the café.

execution.heading: What this means for clients
body: The same loop we run for ourselves — plan, shoot, edit, post, look at what worked — is what we run for the businesses we partner with.
